'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Todd Benard LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Todd Benard]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4)|VB4-L-carefulplanning-pre.gif|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Todd Bernard
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
